title: Container Bookings: final decision and amount of goodwill on a customer roll fee
content:
## Rule
A goodwill waiver of a Container Bookings customer roll fee is written only when every condition of this waiver policy holds, and the waiver amount is then the fee entry's amount rounded to two decimal places. These conditions are added to those of the base goodwill waiver policy: a customer roll fee row that meets every base condition but fails the complete change account, the positive amount or the contract condition is not waived. When any of these conditions fails, no waiver is written, the fee stays payable, and the desk has no authority to reduce it. The quota and once-per-row conditions of the base goodwill waiver policy continue to decide whether a waiver may be written at all.

## Decision table
| Conditions of this waiver policy | Base quota and once-only conditions | Result |
|---|---|---|
| all hold | both hold | waiver of the fee entry's full amount, rounded to two decimals |
| any one fails | any | no waiver; the fee stays payable |
| all hold | either fails | no waiver |

## Wrong reading and correct basis
*Hypothetical figures, for illustration only.*
| Wrong reading | Correct basis |
|---|---|
| A fee entry of 180.00 against an authority of 150.00 can be waived down by 150.00. | No waiver is written; the desk has no authority to reduce the fee. |
| Meeting the base conditions is enough. | The added conditions must hold as well. |
| The waiver may be for less than the entry to stay inside a limit. | The waiver, when granted, is the entry's full amount. |
